Method of Attack: Stealing authentication tokens stored in clear text by Microsoft Teams desktop app
Abusing API call to send messages to oneself to exfiltrate tokens
Information-stealing malware stealing tokens to bypass MFA and gain full account access
Impacted Systems: Microsoft Teams desktop app for Windows
Microsoft Teams desktop app for Linux
Microsoft Teams desktop app for Mac
Attack Vector: Local access to system where Microsoft Teams is installed
Accessing unprotected token storage files (Cookies folder, leveldb ldb files)
Abuse of Electron app architecture storing tokens in clear text
Indicators of Compromise: Access tokens found in clear text in leveldb ldb files
Tokens received as text messages in attacker’s personal chat via API abuse
